notes.title: Version 0.1.14-alpha
notes.notes: [h2]Map Changes[/h2][list][*][p]Several existing rooms within the facility have been revamped, and a few new ones have been introduced. (Please note many of these rooms are still very much so work-in-progress. Feedback on them is appreciated!)[/p][/*][*][p]Breakable Glass has been introduced in some of these rooms.[/p][/*][*][p]A new vertical door type has been introduced.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Physics Props[/h2][list][*][p]Over 100 new physics props have been introduced.[/p][/*][*][p]These props can be found around the facility, or spawned via a menu in the admin panel.[/p][/*][*][p]Some props can be damaged and destroyed (currently only the explosive barrel.)[/p][/*][/list][h2]Main Menu Redesign[/h2][list][*][p]The main menu is now in an office setting, with the server list and options displayed on a monitor.[/p][/*][*][p]Please note the design is not final, we just wanted to get this done quickly for the playtest.[/p][/*][/list][h2]SCP-173 Redesign[/h2][list][*][p]SCP-173 has received a new model and sound effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Gameplay changes will be coming in a future update.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Item Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Keycard ranks have been revamped, and more of them can be found around the facility. (Mainly LCZ.)[/p][/*][*][p]The Medkit has received a new model.[/p][/*][*][p]Grenades are red now.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now aim with the Short Range SMG.[/p][/*][/list][h2]New Sounds & Music[/h2][list][*][p]HCZ and LCZ doors have received new sound effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Tesla Gates have received powerful new zapping sounds.[/p][/*][*][p]The Short Range SMG and Pistol have received new gunshot sounds.[/p][/*][*][p]All SCPs (except 457) have received stingers and chase themes.[/p][/*][*][p]Surface Zone has a new ambient track.[/p][/*][*][p]MTF have a new spawn wave theme.[/p][/*][/list]
